system.connect: Phone Wi‑Fi to bike CCU; password on CCU under left side panel (S/N area)
system.bar_switch: Two slots: Map1 (light off) and Map2 (blue lit). Throttle closed to switch while riding.
system.stock_gotcha: Factory often ships the same stock map in BOTH slots until you upload via the app — Map2 is useless until you load a second map.
system.share_reality: App can share/email proprietary .map files between phones. Website cannot dump a true one-tap paste into the ECU. Best site UX: labeled cards + empty FI/IG 4×4 templates + Copy checklist + load steps; optional screenshot slot for Kyle’s real maps.
load_steps: Download Power Tuner and connect to bike Wi‑Fi (password on CCU).
Enter FI and IG values from the card (or paste from a shared .map file in-app).
Upload (up arrow) to Map1 or Map2.
Confirm on the bar switch: light off = Map1, blue = Map2.

disclaimer: Not OEM warranty advice. Do not invent or trust unverified grid numbers. Paste Kyle’s real Power Tuner screenshots / values before publishing numeric cells. Closed-course / race use only. Verify in Yamaha Power Tuner app after upload.

maps.label: Smooth Linear (Kyle)
maps.whenToUse: Default / learning / slippery — Kyle’s saved Smooth Linear
maps.riderNotes: From Kyle Power Tuner screenshot. Last Sent Map2 07/11/2026. FI richer toward top; IG retarded for smoother delivery. Match POSITION axes exactly (FI TH 20/40/60/80 @ 5/7.5/10/12k; IG TH 15/30/50/70).
maps.card_tip: Reset here before you chase a new tune. FI/IG trims at 0 = stock baseline.

maps.label: Yamaha Exciting Power
maps.whenToUse: Official Yamaha profile — strong overall character for the YZ250F.
maps.riderNotes: Listed as 2021 YZ250F on Yamaha site; same-generation candidate for 2022 — confirm in Power Tuner when importing. Download .yptsjsnz then open/share in the app.
maps.card_tip: Prefer the .yptsjsnz download into Power Tuner if your phone can open/share it; otherwise enter the grids with matching POSITION axes.

maps.label: Map10 (Kyle) — Hard / Rich FI
maps.whenToUse: When you want more fuel hit with stock ignition timing (IG zeros)
maps.riderNotes: From Kyle Power Tuner screenshot “Map10”. FI rich mid–top; IG flat zeros. Map11 in the same dump matches Smooth Linear exactly — not stored separately.
maps.card_tip: Quicker throttle than stock — the Map 2 most riders load first. Prefer Yamaha built-in preset or verified cells.

maps.label: Hard Pack
maps.whenToUse: Firm, slick hardpack — tractable drive, less wheelspin.
maps.riderNotes: Community Power Tuner style map; enter from trusted chart or your own tune — do not invent cells.
maps.card_tip: Tractable mid; less spin than Aggressive. Verified source only.

maps.label: Loam / Deep Sand (Kyle)
maps.whenToUse: Loam or deep sand needing more fuel and softer ignition
maps.riderNotes: From Kyle Power Tuner screenshot “Loam / Deep Sand”. FI heavily enriched at mid–high throttle; IG retarded across the board. Match POSITION axes.
maps.card_tip: Harder mid hit so the tire can dig. Verified source only.

maps.label: Mud / Slippery
maps.whenToUse: Wet, slick, muddy — softer delivery to cut spin.
maps.riderNotes: Pair with Stock/Smooth mindset; prioritize traction over punch.
maps.card_tip: Softer delivery; don’t stack Aggressive on ice-slick clay.

maps.label: Keefer Free Feeling
maps.whenToUse: Less engine braking, freer high-rpm feel, more balanced chassis off throttle.
maps.riderNotes: Keefer Free Feeling — different POSITION axes than Top End/Rev (80/60/40/20). Do not mix charts.
sources: Keefer Inc. 2023 optional maps — Free Feeling image
maps.card_tip: Less engine braking / freer mid-corner. Often run with stock 13/50. Axes are 80/60/40/20 — not the 15/5 Top End chart.

maps.label: Keefer Top End / Rev (Mid-Top)
maps.whenToUse: More mid–top pull through 2nd–4th; Yamaha R&D / Keefer Mid-Top End chart.
maps.riderNotes: Keefer 2022 baseline Mid-Top End and 2023 Top End/Rev show the same grids. Explicitly OK for 2022–2023 YZ250F.
maps.card_tip: This is the chart we first transcribed (was mislabeled Free Feeling). Match FI axes 80/60/15/5 and IG 90/60/25/10.

maps.label: TP Map 2019 (Travis Preston)
maps.whenToUse: Classic TP feel — 2019-gen reference; try on 2022 only if Power Tuner accepts the file.
maps.riderNotes: Yamaha hosts tp-map-2019-yz250f.yptsjsnz. Racer X published a 2019-gen screenshot (not guaranteed identical to current Yamaha file). Prefer the official .yptsjsnz import.
sources: Racer X 2018 TP map article (2019 bike)
maps.card_tip: Download the Yamaha .yptsjsnz first; Racer X grids are for manual entry if import fails.

maps.label: Track Day
maps.whenToUse: Practice / track day: Map1 Stock-Smooth for warm-up, Map2 Aggressive or Keefer Free Feeling once up to temp.
maps.riderNotes: Link to track-day kit BOM + oil/air/chain Jobs checklist before you leave the truck.
maps.card_tip: Map1 Stock warm-up · Map2 Aggressive or Keefer when hot. Check oil/air/chain/kit first.

maps.label: Cool Morning
maps.whenToUse: Cold ambient / cool morning practice — slightly richer / smoother until the bike is fully warm (user preference).
maps.riderNotes: Template only until Kyle’s real cool-weather map exists.
maps.card_tip: Template until Kyle’s cool-weather map exists.

maps.label: Hot Afternoon
maps.whenToUse: Hot weather / thin air afternoon — lean toward maps that don’t feel boggy when heat-soaked (user preference).
maps.riderNotes: Template only until Kyle’s real hot-weather map exists.
maps.card_tip: Template until Kyle’s hot-weather map exists.

maps.label: Map11 (Kyle) = Smooth Linear
maps.whenToUse: Same numbers as Smooth Linear — Kyle’s alternate save name
maps.riderNotes: Identical FI/IG to Smooth Linear in the Sep 9 screenshots. Use Smooth Linear card for copy.

valuesPolicy: Verified: Stock zeros, Yamaha Exciting Power (profile image), Keefer Free Feeling, Keefer Top End/Rev, TP 2019 Racer X screenshot (2019-gen caveat). Empty community labels remain null.

copy.section_intro: Power Tuner maps for the 2022 YZ250F. Your bike holds two maps; the bar switch flips between them (throttle closed). Stock often ships the same map in both slots — Map 2 only gets useful after you load a second map. Copy grids → enter in Power Tuner → upload. Not a one-tap .map install.

starter_pair.Map2: Aggressive or Keefer Free Feeling — punch / freer chassis

copy.air_note: Kyle runs Twin Air Powerflow 152222C — maps assume a clean filter.
copy.axis_warning: Always match POSITION + RPM axes when copying charts (wrong scale makes a map feel dead).

downloads.note: Yamaha .yptsjsnz files are proprietary Power Tuner maps — open/share via the app after download. Not ECU firmware.
